attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Renaming shape templates (TwitterSettings_Edit→XSettings_Edit, TwitterSigninSettings_Edit→XSigninSettings_Edit) and admin menu item ids (twitter→x) could silently break any downstream theme/module that overrides those specific view names or targets the old menu id, though the config key change is backward-compatible and feature IDs are preserved."}

reason: Renaming shape templates (TwitterSettings_Edit→XSettings_Edit, TwitterSigninSettings_Edit→XSigninSettings_Edit) and admin menu item ids (twitter→x) could silently break any downstream theme/module that overrides those specific view names or targets the old menu id, though the config key change is backward-compatible and feature IDs are preserved.
